svg.title: Solved finite uniform cloud with pressure feedback
svg.desc: Inside radius Rc the pressure includes a uniform particular solution p0 and regular spherical function j0 with coefficient A and wave number ki. Outside the cloud pressure pb propagates at kl to the observer r.
